taskBinding.contractRevisionRule: the receiver must observe a pushed HEAD that contains this exact contract; the later verifier binds that observed revision and the contract canonical hash without making the contract self-reference its future commit
taskBinding.decision: Can the exact already-installed official route complete one bounded preview-through-cleanup task-time transaction for the validated scorecard without capability addition, persistent projection, or material user tool intervention?

separateAuthorization.source: active user instruction in the current Codex task
separateAuthorization.scope: execute the agreed O3 real-task evaluation and capability lifecycle after the O4 event
separateAuthorization.repositoryAttestationLimit: the repository records the bounded scope but cannot cryptographically attest the external conversation

capabilityIdentity.payloadPolicy: load exact installed bodies into one fresh receiver context only; do not vendor, rewrite, install, enable, or persist them

hostAuthoritySurface.surface: fresh sub-agent context plus repository and exact temporary-root filesystem operations
hostAuthoritySurface.constraintAndObservation: the event prompt declares exact paths; installed Skill hashes, Git before and after facts, temporary-root absence, and the product verifier observe the named surfaces after execution
hostAuthoritySurface.unsupportedAttestation: the prompt allowlist is not a host path sandbox, and this repository cannot prove absence of transient or out-of-scope filesystem effects, cryptographic context erasure, or a Skill-loader event log

phaseSemantics.preview: inspect the pushed contract, scorecard, exact Skill identities, Git state, absent temporary root, and absent raw evidence path before route use
phaseSemantics.boundedActivation: load the exact Skill bodies into the fresh receiver and apply their instructions only to the named scorecard checkpoint; this is task-time instruction use, not installation, enablement, exposure, or persistent activation
phaseSemantics.observation: record one compact data-quality and KPI checkpoint plus an exact temporary marker and its hash
phaseSemantics.applicableProjection: record not-applicable when no manager or consumer projection is required or authorized, and make no projection mutation
phaseSemantics.rollback: stop applying the selected route in the receiver, verify both installed Skill hashes are unchanged, and record zero capability-configuration mutation; this does not prove cryptographic context erasure
phaseSemantics.cleanup: remove the exact temporary root, verify it is absent, and retain only the bounded raw event evidence path

eventContract.outputFormat: one compact JSON object identical to the raw evidence file and no Markdown
eventContract.preflightFailurePolicy: A failed preflight precedes the lifecycle phases: return one compact refusal JSON to the parent only, write no file, preserve the refusal as counterevidence, and do not rerun without causal review.
eventContract.prompt: You are /root/o3_official_lifecycle_transaction, the single lifecycle owner for one real Agent Autonomy Harness O3 task-time transaction. Work only in C:/Projects/agent-autonomy-harness with forkTurns none. Do not spawn sub-agents. First read product/evidence/o3-official-lifecycle-transaction-contract-2026-08-11.json from the current pushed HEAD and obey it exactly; report the observed revision so the parent verifier can prove that revision contains the exact contract. Treat 19ee6f5c2b7feb47cbe41e40f5983c13d5ec2e45 only as the scorecard source baseline. Before any write record strict RFC3339 startedAt and require git status --porcelain=v1 -uall to return no lines, the exact temporary child .tmp/o3-official-lifecycle-transaction-2026-08-11 to be absent, and product/evidence/o3-official-lifecycle-transaction-raw-2026-08-11.json to be absent; otherwise stop without writing. Verify main, origin/main, 0/0, the validated scorecard canonical hash, and both named installed OpenAI Skill SHA-256 values. Read both exact SKILL.md bodies completely. Preview the bounded route, then load and apply analyze-data-quality followed by design-kpis only to this narrow checkpoint: confirm the scorecard's 60 decision entries remain non-Cartesian, determine whether its current source evidence supports the no-capability-addition decision, and define one decision KPI with its caveat. For observation, create only the exact temporary child, write one compact marker JSON, and record its SHA-256. Record applicableProjection as not-applicable when no manager or consumer projection is required or authorized. Roll back task-time route use by ceasing the Skill-guided analysis, re-hashing both Skill bodies, and observing named mutation surfaces; do not claim cryptographic context erasure or a host path sandbox. Attempt exact cleanup and record the actual result. Write one initial compact JSON object to product/evidence/o3-official-lifecycle-transaction-raw-2026-08-11.json and finalize the same file after recording actual post git status. Populate every nested field from expectedRawEvidence, use strictly increasing phase timestamps in phaseOrder, and return byte-for-byte the same final JSON with no Markdown or extra text. If any phase fails, user intervention occurs, KPI reverses, or unexpected mutation or residue appears, emit a structurally valid transaction-failed-with-evidence receipt with the actual counters, deltas, failed or not-run phases, and evidence; never force the successPhaseStates or success values. Only a genuinely successful transaction may use transaction-observed-with-runtime-attestation-limit and the declared success predicates. The path allowlist is a task constraint, not host enforcement; report that limitation. Do not intentionally modify any other path and do not claim complete absence of transient out-of-scope effects, behavior, value, cross-host portability, production, release, publication, overall O3, or v0.1 acceptance.

expectedRawEvidence.strictTimeFormat: RFC3339 full-date T full-time with seconds and Z or numeric offset

verification: contract canonical hash and prompt hash
pushed baseline revision and fresh forkTurns-none receiver identity
exact scorecard and installed Skill hashes
phase-specific receipts and compact KPI observation
exact temporary-root absence and Git before and after facts
mutation tests reject self-declared identity, phases, repository state, cleanup, and claim limits
claimLimits: This contract authorizes one bounded fresh receiver transaction on the named public local sources and exact paths only.
Bounded activation means task-time Skill instruction loading and use in the fresh receiver; it does not prove installation, enablement, exposure, persistent activation, or model behavior.
Rollback proves cessation of the named task route plus unchanged Skill hashes and zero declared capability configuration mutation; it does not prove cryptographic context erasure.
A not-applicable projection receipt proves no projection was needed for this route, not general projection support.
The event may support O3 only together with the separately validated sparse scorecard and public fail-closed verifier.
The prompt path allowlist is a task constraint, not a host sandbox; repository checks cannot prove absence of transient or out-of-scope filesystem effects.
The event does not prove cross-host portability, production readiness, release readiness, publication readiness, broad user value, or v0.1 acceptance.
